rows.subject: Local sufficient condition and area/compliance coupling
rows.required: For positive D and a passive symmetric connection operator, C_conn <= (1/chi_star-1)D in Loewner order implies (D+C_conn)^(-1) >= chi_star D^(-1). A site-only C_s condition is sufficient locally only with a demonstrated global decomposition and allocated per-edge compliance allowance, including both sites/ends and all crosssite terms. Scalar independent-edge example: c_total <= (1/chi_star-1)L/(E*A); at A=A0/chi_star this becomes c_total <= (1-chi_star)L/(E*A0). With fixed c_total, baseline EA0/L requires A>=A0/(1-E*A0*c_total/L), with denominator>0. These are symbolic conditions, not qualifications.
rows.evidence: Complete compatible operator uncertainty upper envelope and area/state records; local diagonal limits alone fail to bound the full operator.
